overview_description.description:
Digital marketing is just a few taps away. 
Discover micro-influencers and new keywords for your brand. Create and launch expert Google Ads and YouTube Ads in minutes.  Get the answers you need, fast from Google Analytics and more with voice command.

No marketing experience required or technical mumbo-jumbo. Plai is easy to set up with a few taps, and available on the go. 

It's like having a full-cycle marketing team in your pocket!

Stay informed
Plai provides tools to help you market. Before creating a marketing campaign or even a social post, you can access trending content in your niche, discover relevant keywords, and learn the latest marketing strategies.

Grow your brand
Our tools, services, and information are built to be intuitive and accessible for everyone — newcomers and experts alike. Plai uses cutting-edge marketing strategies to help brands create and optimize their digital marketing campaigns in just a few taps.

about_short_description.short_description: Plai is a digital marketing application platform that provides advertising tools to small teams and creators to make marketing easier.

product.name: Plai Advertising Platform
product.description: A platform that enables users to create, launch, and manage digital advertising campaigns across multiple major ad platforms using AI-driven tools.

product.name: Optimize for Me
product.description: An AI-powered feature that continuously monitors and automatically optimizes Google and Facebook ad campaigns by adjusting creatives, targeting, and keywords.

product.name: Plai Social Posting Feature
product.description: A tool for creating, scheduling, and managing social media posts across multiple platforms from a single dashboard.

product.name: Plai Whitelabel Ad Tool
product.description: A customizable white-label solution that enables agencies to offer AI-powered ad creation and management services under their own branding.

product.name: Plai Blacklabel
product.description: A management system for large agencies to oversee multiple white-label agencies and client accounts from a centralized dashboard.
